title: CustomDrops Pro
description: A plugin that lets you edit the rewards received from monsters. Supports IA IE IT MM and can be easily edited.
body:
👑 LootCore / MythicDrops – Advanced Mob Rewards System
📝 Overview 
An advanced, lightweight, and highly customizable Minecraft server plugin designed for version 1.21+. This plugin completely overhauls how mob drops and rewards work on your server. It allows server administrators to assign custom money rewards (via Vault) and dynamic item drops to any vanilla Minecraft mob or custom-named mythic boss.

With full support for advanced features like Custom Model Data (Textures), custom lore, and enchantments, this is the ultimate solution for RPG, Survival, Skyblock, and Factions servers looking to reward players for hunting monsters.

🚀 Key Features 
💰 Economy Integration: Reward players with customizable amounts of money instantly upon killing a mob (Requires Vault).

⚔️ Texture & Resource Pack Support: Seamlessly handles Custom Model Data and custom texturing for special weapon/armor drops.

👹 Smart Mob Recognition: Advanced detection system that separates custom mythic bosses (with custom names/colors) from regular vanilla mobs.

📦 In-Game GUI Management: Easily add and manage item drops straight from your inventory using simple administrative commands.

📂 Clean Performance & Logging: Built with modern Java architecture, optimized for 40+ players with absolute zero TPS lag, featuring a clean daily log system for tracking all transactions.

🛠️ Commands & Permissions 
/mg create <key> <display_name> – Create a new reward profile for a mob.

/mg additem <key> – Add the item you are holding in your hand to a mob's loot table.

/mg gui <key> – Open a visual container to inspect or manage a mob's item drops.

Permission: moshegift.admin (Full access to all commands and configuration tools).


⛔ Requirements (Dependencies)
To make this plugin work flawlessly, the following software must be installed on your server:

🟢 Vault (Required): The core economy bridge. CustomDropsPro will safely disable itself upon startup if Vault is missing.

🟢 An Economy Provider (Required): You need a plugin that handles players' balances, such as EssentialsX, CMI, or any dedicated economy plugin that hooks into Vault.


No responsibility is taken for any malfunction that may occur.
